Plan (#266): single-file fix to .design/verified/proof-backends.md — rewrite the REQ-11 ## REQ status table row (line 2414) from the false NOT-STARTED / 'NOTHING of S4.2 is built … lean/Thermite/ has NO whileBodyDenote/…/loopDenote_exits_of_dec and NO PinWhileVacuity.lean/PinWhileComposition.lean' to the SPLIT truth that matches the same doc's Requirements-section REQ-11 entry (lines 413-476, post-#265) and the shipped artifacts.

Authority: the Requirements-section REQ-11 entry — REQ-11.1/11.2/11.3/11.6 SHIPPED (v-a, commit 99c7f304 + the #265 declared h_dec PRE-state adaptation, commit 92659eb7) / REQ-11.4/11.5/11.7 NOT-STARTED (the v-b exporter, open blocker #264).

Mechanical refutation of the stale row: lean/Thermite/Exec/WhileBody.lean ships all six declarations; the three pins exist (PinWhileVacuity/PinWhileComposition/PinWhileDecShape), and PinWhileDecShape imports Thermite.Exec.WhileBody and applies loopDenote_exits_of_dec — kernel existence of the artifacts the row denies.

New row: status cell split SHIPPED (v-a) + NOT-STARTED (v-b, #264); description split into SHIPPED sub-rows (11.1/11.2/11.3/11.6) with the module path, six declaration names, three pins, axiom footprint, the #265 adaptation; and NOT-STARTED sub-rows (11.4/11.5/11.7). House binary-status style preserved (mirrors the REQ-10 row).

Gauntlet: python3 tooling/doc-drift.py exit 0; re-read the new row vs the Requirements-section entry for consistency. Then commit, --kind result, close 266 --no-changelog, session work 264.
